note: Hand-written (phase 5 design 4.4, 5.3; D128, D132). The body of each of the eight preset kinds. TypeScript: BODY_SCHEMAS[kind] in packages/presets/src/schemas.ts (zod); the reader is packages/presets/test/schemas.test.ts. Dart: parsePreset(kind, json) in apps/mobile/lib/presets/ (P2-models), whose test reads the valid cases, the unknown fields and the unknown kinds; it never sees an invalid body, which the server never stores. A valid body parses to itself, with `filled` added where it leaves a field out that has a default: a bundle's prompt and a flag's criteria default to the empty string, which means none. An invalid body fails its schema, and each issue's path (its parts joined by dots, an array index as its number, '' for the body itself) lies at or under one of `paths`, each of which has an issue at or under it: the field at fault, whatever union branch or refinement reports it. Every object is strict: a key the schema does not name is refused on the server, as an unrecognized key at the path of the object that holds it (`unknownFields`: `at` and `key`), and ignored by the phone, which reads such a body as `known` (with `filled`), so an older phone reads a body a later phase grew. A kind the phone does not know (`unknownKinds`: phase 10 adds billing_code_map) is skipped by its parser and has no schema here. The rules: every text is trimmed (one that starts or ends with white space is refused, never trimmed for you), and its length is counted in Unicode code points, as the API's other schemas (zod) and the database's length() count it, and as the phone's text boxes cut it. name: 1 to 80. An id is a UUID as the API's Uuid takes it. order_category: behaviour supply, medication or lab; sort a whole number from 0 to 1,000,000. item: categoryId; unit 1 to 20; medical and captureLot true or false; result null (no result), {type: choice, options: 2 to 12 texts of 1 to 40, no two the same ignoring case (the later one is refused)} or {type: number, unit: 1 to 20}. bundle: medical true or false (the Medical or Non-Medical tag); prompt 0 to 300; lines 1 to 40 of {itemId, qty 1 to 99, core true or false}, no item twice (the later line's itemId is refused). flag: tier primary or secondary; criteria 0 to 500; color one of the keys of `colors`, each with the plain name a pill shows before the flag's own ("Red · High"); rank a whole number from 0 to 1,000,000; sensitive true or false. field_supply_map: noteTypeKey a note type key (^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,60}$); path and when both there or both left out, the one that is missing refused (left out, the map fires once for every note of the type); a path is 2 to 4 parts joined by dots, each ^[a-z][a-zA-Z0-9_]{0,60}$, written without an entry part; when is exactly one of {equals: an option code (^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,40}$), a number or true}, {includes: an option code} or {answered: true}; lines 1 to 10 of {itemId, qty: a whole number from 1 to 99, or {fromPath: a path}}, an item allowed twice. condition_supply_map: codes 1 to 20 ICD-10-CM codes in the shape of 0010_problems.sql (^[A-Z][0-9][0-9A-Z](\.[0-9A-Z]{1,4})?$), exact codes only; lines 1 to 10 of {itemId, qtyPerPatient 1 to 99}. bag: minimums 0 to 200 of {itemId, min 1 to 999}, no item twice. settings: name exactly 'Team settings'; bagMinimumsOn true or false; newBagMinimums as a bag's minimums; problemCheckDays a whole number from 7 to 365. Ids are made up; no body here is checked against a team's presets or a note type, which validatePreset does (preset-validate.json).
